During spring time each year a fresh slab of sand washes ashore to cover Windansea\s iconic clay rock formations. Clean and thick-grained sand remains throughout summer when the water temperature is perfect for swimming. Unlike its tourist-heavy counterparts you won\t find large parking lots waterfront retail or surfboard rentals at Windansea. Instead you\ll find a quiet enclave of sand and clay rock formations that ease into an eclectic range of swimming surfing and play zones where locals of all ages prefer to spend their summer days.   During spring time each year a fresh slab of sand washes ashore to cover Windansea\s iconic clay rock formations. Clean and thick-grained sand remains throughout summer when the water temperature is perfect for swimming. In the fall larger waves and changing currents wash most of the sand away revealing the rocks once again. This natural cycle is the cornerstone of Windansea\s refreshing aesthetic.
